title: Welcome to Paradise - Episode Plan for Monday, 26 October 2026
summary: This episode covers key global and European developments including the deepening crisis in French education protests, the landmark Brazilian presidential election, the anticipated IPO of AI giant Anthropic, escalating tensions and military support in Ukraine, and the racially motivated attack in France's Yvelines region. The episode balances significant European and French news with important global stories, providing diverse perspectives from French, Spanish, Italian, and US sources.
